content: The following references provide a comprehensive overview of various topics related to health, nutrition, biodiversity, and sustainable development: 1. A meta-narrative mapping exercise was published in Health Policy and Planning in 2015, focusing on health policy frameworks and their implications. 2. The 2018 report titled Panorama de la Seguridad Alimentaria y Nutricional en América Latina y el Caribe was produced by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), World Food Programme (WFP), Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), and World Health Organization (WHO). It provides an in-depth analysis of food security and nutrition in Latin America and the Caribbean. 3. The Global Nutrition Report 2018, authored by Fanzo J, Hawkes C, Udomkesmalee E, Afshin A, and others, was published by Development Initiatives in Bristol. It highlights global progress and challenges in addressing malnutrition. 4. The WHO published a technical series in 2019 on adapting to climate-sensitive health impacts, with a focus on undernutrition, emphasizing the intersection of climate change and health. 5. The FAO and WHO jointly released a 2018 report titled Strengthening Nutrition Action, which outlines strategies to enhance nutrition interventions globally. 6. The WHO's 2013 publication, Protecting Health from Climate Change: Vulnerability and Adaptation Assessment, provides a framework for assessing and addressing health risks associated with climate change. 7. The WHO's Health in All Policies: Training Manual (2015) offers guidance on integrating health considerations into policymaking across sectors. 8. The Government of South Australia published a 2017 report, Progressing the Sustainable Development Goals through Health in All Policies: Case Studies from Around the World, showcasing global examples of health-focused policy integration. 9. The WHO's 2018 brochure, Key Learning on Health in All Policies Implementation from Around the World, summarizes lessons learned from implementing health-inclusive policies. 10. The Roadmap to a One Health Agenda 2030, published in 2017 in Perspectives in Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Nutrition, and Natural Resources, outlines strategies for integrating human, animal, and environmental health. 11. Walton M's 2019 book, One Planet, One Health, published by Sydney University Press, explores the interconnectedness of planetary and human health. 12. The World Resources Institute (2018) released a report titled Creating a Sustainable Food Future, which examines strategies for achieving global food security sustainably. 13. The FAO's 2018 publication, Future Smart Food, focuses on the potential of underutilized crops to address food security challenges in Asia. 14. The FAO, in collaboration with the United Nations, published the Global Action Programme on Food Security and Nutrition in Small Island Developing States in 2017, addressing the unique challenges faced by these regions. 15. Tandon N's 2013 report, Opportunities for Advancing Women’s Sustainable and Green Livelihoods, highlights the role of women in food security and climate resilience in the Caribbean. 16. Burlingame B and Dernini S edited the 2012 FAO publication, Sustainable Diets and Biodiversity, which explores the relationship between dietary patterns and biodiversity conservation. 17. 18. Orozco FA and colleagues' 2011 study in Health Promotion International evaluated the outcomes of a community-based program aimed at reducing pesticide-related risks among small farm households. 19. Charron DF's 2012 book, Ecohealth Research in Practice, published by the International Development Research Centre, discusses the application of ecohealth principles in addressing health and environmental challenges. 20. Bjørling-Poulsen M and colleagues' 2008 study in Environmental Health examined the potential developmental neurotoxicity of pesticides used in Europe. 21. The FAO and WHO's 2011 report, Risks and Benefits of Fish Consumption, provides evidence-based recommendations on fish consumption and its health implications. 22. Grandjean P and Landrigan PJ's 2006 article in The Lancet discusses the developmental neurotoxicity of industrial chemicals and their impact on public health. 23. Ford AES and colleagues' 2015 study in Ecohealth integrates human and ecosystem health through ecosystem services frameworks. 24. Soto D and colleagues' 2012 publication, Farming the Waters for People and Food, addresses aquaculture-fisheries interactions using the ecosystem approach to aquaculture. 25. The United Nations' 2019 report, The Future is Now, outlines strategies for achieving sustainable development goals. 26. The FAO's 2017 publication, Guidance on Integrating Biodiversity Considerations into One Health Approaches, emphasizes the importance of biodiversity in health and nutrition. 27. Zimmerer KS and de Haan S's 2017 article in Nature Plants explores the role of agrobiodiversity in creating a sustainable food future. 28. Mujtar EL and colleagues' 2019 study in Global Food Security examines the role of soil biodiversity in food security and nutrition. 29. The FAO and WHO's 2019 report, Sustainable Healthy Diets, provides guidelines for promoting health and sustainability through dietary choices. 30. Johnston JL and colleagues' 2014 article in Advances in Nutrition analyzes the determinants and processes influencing sustainable diets and their impact on health and the environment. 31. Swinburn BA and colleagues' 2019 Lancet Commission Report highlights the global syndemic of obesity, undernutrition, and climate change. 32. Hunter D and colleagues' 2016 article in Frontiers in Nutrition examines the role of biodiversity in improving nutrition. 33. 34. Remans R and colleagues' 2017 publication, Towards an Agrobiodiversity Index for Sustainable Food Systems, proposes a framework for measuring agrobiodiversity. 35. The 2020 book, Biodiversity, Food, and Nutrition: A New Agenda for Sustainable Food Systems, published by Routledge, explores the integration of biodiversity into food systems. 36. 37. Burlingame B and colleagues' 2019 chapter in Advances in Food Security and Sustainability highlights the role of agricultural biodiversity in Pacific Small Island Developing States. 38. Mijatovic D and colleagues' 2018 publication, Mainstreaming Biodiversity in Production Landscapes, discusses strategies for integrating biodiversity into agricultural systems. 39. The 2006 decision of the Conference of the Parties (VIII/23) emphasizes the importance of biodiversity conservation in sustainable development. 40. Norström AV and colleagues' 2020 article in Nature Sustainability outlines principles for knowledge co-production in sustainability research. 41. Montana J's 2019 article in Sustainability Science examines the organizational dimensions of global biodiversity expert processes. 42. Johns T and colleagues' 2006 publication, Understanding the Links Between Agriculture and Health, explores the interconnections between these fields. 43. Rüegg SR and colleagues' 2018 article in Frontiers in Veterinary Science evaluates One Health initiatives using a systems approach. 44. Hahn T and colleagues' 2006 study in Human Ecology highlights the role of bridging organizations in adaptive co-management of wetland landscapes. 45. The WHO's 2014 publication, Gender, Climate Change, and Health, addresses the intersection of these critical issues. 46. The WHO's 2014 guidance on health adaptation planning provides strategies for protecting health from climate change. 47. Tandon N's 2013 working paper, Opportunities for Advancing Women’s Sustainable and Green Livelihoods, focuses on empowering women in the Caribbean. 48. The WHO's 2017 publication, Double-Duty Actions for Nutrition, outlines strategies for addressing malnutrition and its underlying causes. 49. The 2015 report, Agriculture for Nutrition and Health, by the International Food Policy Research Institute, explores the role of agriculture in improving health outcomes. 50. Fanzo J's 2013 book, Diversifying Food and Diets, published by Routledge, emphasizes the importance of dietary diversity. 51. The WHO and FAO's 2003 publication, Diet, Nutrition, and the Prevention of Chronic Diseases, provides evidence-based recommendations for reducing the burden of chronic diseases. 52. Alae-Carew C and colleagues' 2020 systematic review in Environmental Research Letters examines the impact of environmental changes on the nutritional quality of fruits, nuts, and seeds. 53. Gomez San Juan M and colleagues' 2019 FAO publication, Towards a Sustainable Bioeconomy, explores strategies for achieving sustainability in the bioeconomy. 54. The United Nations' 2011 report, Towards a Green Economy, outlines pathways for transitioning to sustainable economic systems. 55. Bringezu S's 2019 article in Resources discusses science-based targets for sustainable resource use. 56. Palmer MA and Febria CM's 2012 article in Science highlights the critical role of ecosystems in maintaining environmental health. 57. The 2018 Global Bioeconomy Summit Communiqué emphasizes the importance of bioeconomy in achieving sustainable development. 58. Contento IR's 2008 article in Asia Pacific Journal of Clinical Nutrition links nutrition education with research, theory, and practice. 59. Hunter D and colleagues' 2019 article in Planta explores the potential of neglected and underutilized species for improving diets and nutrition. 60. Jabbar MA and colleagues' 2000 publication, Agro-Ecosystems, Natural Resources Management, and Human Health Research in East Africa, examines the interconnections between these fields. 61. Catley A and colleagues' 2011 article in The Veterinary Journal discusses participatory epidemiology approaches and methods. 62. Bagnol B's 2012 publication, Advocate Gender Issues, highlights sustainable strategies for controlling Newcastle Disease in village chickens. 63. Jibril AH and colleagues' 2015 article in The Journal of Applied Poultry Research investigates Newcastle Disease among rural farmers in Nigeria using participatory epidemiology techniques. 64. Azhar M and colleagues' 2010 article in Avian Diseases discusses participatory disease surveillance and response in Indonesia. 65. Fanzo J and Davis C's 2019 article in Current Obesity Reports explores the feasibility of diets that are healthy, sustainable, and equitable. 66. The FAO's 2017 publication, Nutrition-Sensitive Agriculture and Food Systems in Practice, provides practical guidance for integrating nutrition into agriculture. 67. Payne CL and colleagues' 2016 systematic review in Public Health Nutrition examines the relationship between low-carbon-emission diets and health outcomes. 68. The World Resources Report: Creating a Sustainable Food Future (2018) synthesizes strategies for achieving global food security. 69. Blesh J and colleagues' 2019 article in World Development explores the role of sustainable food systems in addressing global challenges. 70. Fan S's 2019 report, Food Policy in 2018–2019, highlights the urgency of addressing the Sustainable Development Goals. 71. Springmann M and colleagues' 2018 article in Nature examines options for keeping the food system within environmental limits. 72. Medawar E and colleagues' 2019 systematic review in Translational Psychiatry explores the effects of plant-based diets on the body and brain. 73. Zmora N and colleagues' 2019 article in Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology discusses the relationship between diet, health, and the gut microbiota. 74. The 2018 InterAcademy Partnership report highlights opportunities for future research and innovation in food and nutrition security. 75. Thies E's 2000 publication, Promising and Underutilized Species Crops and Breeds, emphasizes the potential of neglected species in sustainable agriculture. 76. Foyer CH and colleagues' 2016 article in Nature Plants discusses the consequences of neglecting legumes for human health and sustainable food production. 77. Khoury CK and colleagues' 2014 article in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA examines the increasing homogeneity in global food supplies and its implications for food security. 78. Negri V's 2012 publication, Policies Supportive of On-Farm Conservation, explores strategies for conserving neglected and underutilized species. 79. The 2017 Global Land Outlook by the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification provides insights into sustainable land management. 80. Sachs J and colleagues' 2017 SDG Index and Dashboard Report evaluates global progress toward achieving the Sustainable Development Goals. 81. Hunter D and colleagues' 2020 submission to the Post-2020 Global Biodiversity Framework emphasizes the integration of food systems, biodiversity, and nutrition into global policy frameworks.
